title: BME280
text: Measure barometric air pressure, relative humidity, and temperature from BME280 sensor, 4 outputs; {I2C module} sets the module for communication, {I2C address}, {Pressure (Pa)} sets the output port for reading pressure, {Temperature (℃)} sets the output port for reading temperature, {Humidity (%)} sets the output port for reading humidity, {Status} sets the output port for obtaining status of values, {Filter coefficient}, {Stand by time} sets the standby time to read values, {Pressure oversampling factor} sets the oversampling factor for the measured pressure, {Humidity oversampling factor} sets the oversampling factor for the measured humidity, {Temperature oversampling factor} sets the oversampling factor for the measured humidity, {Data type} sets the output data type for values from BME280 sensor and {Sample time} sets the time interval to read data. Values come from the instance.
